0022600142.text: Dallas hosts Oklahoma City in the Mavericks' fifth game of the season, with Dallas at 2-2 and 8th in the West, 2 games back in the Southwest, while the Thunder are unbeaten at 4-0, 1st in the West, and riding a four-game win streak. Dallas is 0-1 at home and 2-1 on the road, Oklahoma City is 3-0 at home and 1-0 on the road, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Mavericks lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, Naji Marshall, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, and Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso, Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh and Thomas Sorber.
